current_evidence: Searches turned up no newer Eastbourne list. The 'Apply for planning permission' page still refers to the Eastbourne (EBC) validation list and the householder checklist; planning.data.gov.uk (entity 20073, entry-date 2026-10-16) records this xlsx as Eastbourne's local list. The democracy-site 'Planning Local Validation List' report I could read (s20501) is Lewes District Council's (Cabinet, 10 June 2021); the second report (s26735) could not be fetched.

issues.detail: The list date is null and 'Outdated (>2y)?' is 'Undated'. The workbook's own excerpts show the material is old: the householder checklist reads 'Version Number 1.1 / September 2015', and the Excel list cites 'Core Strategy Local Plan 2013', 'Borough Plan 2007' and 'CLG 2010'. It should be flagged as probably outdated (>2y). The ?m= values in the URLs are upload timestamps from about 13 July 2023, not list dates. planning.data.gov.uk's start-date of 2024-01-01 is not a list date either.
issues.evidence: 'Page 3 of 6 Version Number 1.1 / September 2015'; 'Core Strategy Local Plan 2013 Policy D5'; 'National requirement & CLG 2010'

issues.detail: All 6 'Submission rules' tab items are website boilerplate, not validation requirements: the Planning Portal guide note, 'Find out which type of planning permission you need', the paper-form email/postal address, the personal data publication notice, the advice not to include personal details, and the privacy notice link.
issues.evidence: 'Paper copies of all forms ... submit by email via PlanningFirst@lewes-eastbourne.gov.uk or by post to Planning First...'; 'please read our planning privacy notice'

issues.detail: Excel cells were run together, so triggers belong to the wrong rows. (a) The CIL row has the Design and Access Statement's threshold ('Yes if floorspace created is 100sqm or more or more than 1 dwelling proposed') instead of its own ('Additional Information Requirement Form'). (b) The Affordable Housing row's excerpt runs into the Archaeological Assessment row ('If over 5 dwellings proposed, full...'). (c) The Biodiversity row runs into the CIL and DAS rows. (d) The Roof plan row runs on through Assessment of Significance, CIL and DAS.
issues.evidence: CIL excerpt: 'Community Infrastructure Levy | | Additional Information Requirement Form (available here) Design and Access Statement | Core Strategy Local Plan 2013 Policy D8 ... | | Yes if floorspace created is 100sqm or more...'

issues.detail: Several Householder triggers are wrong. (a) The Design and Access Statement excerpt is a list of download links from the planning page ('Eastbourne Validation List ( Excel doc, 72 KB ) ...'), not a trigger. (b) The Heritage Statement trigger is narrowed to 'where property is situated within an Archaeological Notification Area', but the list applies it to any application involving a listed building, scheduled monument, conservation area or ANA. (c) The Planning Statement row reuses the heritage text and has no trigger of its own. (d) The Highways/visibility splays and Tree Assessment excerpts run into the Flood Risk and photomontage items.
issues.evidence: Householder DAS excerpt: 'Design and access statements Eastbourne Borough Council ( PDF, 75 KB ) (opens new window) Eastbourne Validation List ( Excel doc, 72 KB )'

issues.detail: The Heritage Statement form and the HER Consultation report are missing from Listed building consent, Demolition in conservation area and Outline. Those rows say '(none)' or list only Archaeological Assessment, yet Grokbot's own extracted text says any application involving a listed building, scheduled monument, conservation area or ANA needs a Heritage Statement form and, unless minor, an HER Consultation report.
issues.evidence: 'Any application which involves a listed building, scheduled monument or falls within a conservation or an archaeological notification area will be required to submit a completed Heritage Statement form AND unless minor will also be required to submit a HER Consultation report.'

issues.detail: 'Assessment of Significance' (Saved Policy UHT17 of the Borough Plan 2007; 'YES as informed and supplemented by HER Statement') shows up inside the Roof plan excerpt but is not captured as a requirement. The planning page also names a 'Heritage Statement and Assessment of Significance pro-forma' for EBC heritage applications.
issues.evidence: 'Assessment of Significance | Saved Policy UHT17 of the Borough Plan 2007 | YES as informed and supplemented by HER Statement'

issues.detail: Eight Excel-list rows are put under 'Full planning' with the 'INFERRED' note (Affordable Housing, Biodiversity, Block plan, CIL, DAS, Elevations, Heritage, Roof plan). Meanwhile Outline, Reserved matters, LBC, Advertisement, S73 and the other app types all say '(none)', although the Excel list is a general list for all EBC applications. Archaeological Assessment is put under Full planning and LBC because the text matched 'MAJOR application' and 'listed building'; the source ties it to major applications, ANA sites and over-5-dwelling schemes, not to LBC as such.
issues.evidence: Notes: 'INFERRED: application type not named in extracted text of a general local list; placed under Full planning'; Archaeology excerpt: 'Contact county.archaeology@eastsussex.gov.uk ... If over 5 dwellings proposed'

issues.detail: The heritage/HER tab item appears twice, differing only by a trailing full stop. Two 'Drawing / document standards' items repeat the same '1:100 or 1:50 ... metric scale bar' rule. The drawing-scale items are fragments ending in 'What information is required:'.
issues.evidence: tab_items 'Local forms / checklists' 1 and 2; Drawing standards items 3 and 4

issues.detail: The workbook does not note that applications in the South Downs National Park part of the borough use the SDNP local validation list, which the planning page refers to.
issues.evidence: Planning page names a separate 'SDNP local validation list' for South Downs National Park applications
issues.claude_response: Grok could not verify this, so the finding stands until someone checks it by hand.

summary: The workbook link is still the only Eastbourne list found, but the council site returned errors, so I could not read the source. Grokbot's own excerpts show the list is undated legacy material (2015 checklist, 2013/2007 policies). The extraction mixes up Excel rows (the CIL row has the DAS threshold), counts website boilerplate as requirements, and leaves Heritage Statement/HER off LBC and the other app types.

WebFetch got a client error (4xx) on the Excel list and on the householder checklist PDF, and the planning page showed an 'emergency maintenance' banner and no document links. The link may be broken or only blocked to automated fetching; Grokbot reported downloading it this run. The checks below rely on the workbook's own excerpts.
